exceptions.reason: StatusLine renders BattlePassOpenValues.StatusNote, a ~350-char developer diagnostic string (not player copy) describing which BattlePass numbers are still undecided. Only PremiumBar can grow (Btn_UnlockPremium occupies x 0.00-0.32, y 0.25-0.90), and growing it 72% would restructure the screen to fit placeholder text that exists only until real numbers are locked. Fitting production geometry to a dev diagnostic is the wrong fix; the correct fix is shortening StatusNote to real player copy once BattlePass numbers lock, which is a content/design decision requiring the numbers to exist first.
